sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems DCS-DTC types into the cockpit when uploading. Order: waypoints (MFD WP page), then radios (COMMS page). Uses the C-130 command delay. The page re-creates a null system.

sections.label: Waypoints
sections.help: Waypoints 1..60. Filled from the dashboard route. The page re-creates a null system, but a null Waypoints.Waypoints list crashes it.

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: Radio6System with 4 radios: 1 UHF, 2 VHF, 3 FM1, 4 FM2; 10 presets, each preset holds one frequency per radio. The page re-creates a null system; Radios.Radio must not be null. Radio upload is best effort (unfinished uploader).

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where points captured on the DCS F10 map (Ctrl+Shift+D dialog) are inserted into the waypoint list. App-side only, never uploaded. The page re-creates a null system.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "OH58D". The loader picks the C# configuration type from this value; it must match the preset folder / Load page.

fields.label: Format version
fields.help: Always 2. A missing Version (or 1) together with a missing Upload sends the file to the V1 converter, which throws for this aircraft.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text shown (and editable) in the in-game DCS-DTC kneeboard dialog (Ctrl+Shift+K). Not a system: Load/Save never copies it, only a whole preset file carries it.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Type the waypoints on the MFD WP page (DMS whole seconds).

fields.label: Radios
fields.help: Program presets and selected modes. Requires Radio.Presets non-null, every preset with 4 Frequencies, and SelectedModes with 4 entries in order UHF, VHF, FM1, FM2 (the uploader indexes them by position and throws otherwise).

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Filled from the planned route: route point i -> Sequence i (1..N, unique, sorted); the uploader types "<Sequence>W" for each entry in list order. Max 60.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: Waypoint number 1..60, unique; typed as "<n>W".

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Required (non-empty) by the editor; not uploaded. Use the route point name.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.583’" (2-digit zero-padded degrees, U+00B0 degree sign, U+2019 minute mark). The uploader parses it and re-formats as DMS whole seconds (N421035); an unparseable value aborts the upload.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "E 042°28.950’" (3-digit zero-padded degrees). The uploader parses it and re-formats as DMS whole seconds (N421035); an unparseable value aborts the upload.

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Ground elevation of the point, integer feet MSL (editor range 0..35000). Always typed.

fields.label: Time over steerpoint
fields.help: HH:MM:SS or null; route TOT/ETA if the dashboard has one. Shown in the app and kneeboard only, never uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: True for route target points (shows "TGT" in the list and kneeboard). Not uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Radios
fields.help: Container for the 4 radios.

fields.label: Presets
fields.help: Preset channels 1..10 (the UI shows 10; the uploader accepts Number <= 19). A preset whose four frequencies are all empty is removed by the UI. Use [] rather than null when uploading radios.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset number, unique. Required (constructor parameter).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Preset label; the uploader types the first 7 characters. Null when empty.

fields.label: Frequencies per radio
fields.help: One string per radio, index 0 UHF (225.000-399.975), 1 VHF (118.000-151.975), 2 FM1 and 3 FM2 (30.000-87.975); "" = not set on that radio. 3 integer / 3 fraction digits, 5 kHz steps. A legacy single "Frequency" key is accepted on read as Frequencies[0].

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Frequency for that radio or "" (typed without the decimal point).

fields.label: Selected modes
fields.help: One entry per radio: Number 1 = UHF, Number 2 = VHF, Number 3 = FM1, Number 4 = FM2. The getter drops entries with SelectedMode 1 (Frequency) and both strings empty, on save and on read. The uploader reads entries BY POSITION (0 UHF, 1 VHF, 2 FM1, 3 FM2) and needs all 4: write a radio you do not want to change as { SelectedMode: 2, SelectedPreset: "", SelectedFrequency: "" } so it survives the filter and is skipped.

fields.label: Radio
fields.help: Radio index 1..4. Keep entries ordered 1, 2, 3, 4.

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency tuned in Frequency mode, or "". Same bands as the presets for that radio.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 Frequency, 2 Preset.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset number as a string ("1".."10") or "".

fields.label: Navigation points

options.label: Add to end of the list
Add to end of the first gap

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured non-target points. When the waypoint list comes from the dashboard route, leave 0 (append after the route) so captures in the cockpit do not overwrite route points.

fields.label: Target points

options.label: Add to the end of the list

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured target points. The UI offers only end-of-list (0) and range (2); 1 is accepted on load but has no radio button. This aircraft has no "Add TGT" capture button, so this rarely matters.

fields.label: Navigation range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Navigation points = Add to specific range. A dashboard can set it to (last route sequence + 1) to keep captures clear of the route.

fields.label: Target range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Target points = Add to specific range.
